0.0: Hey there, traveler! I am Keeny, the Alchemist of Magatia. Well, 'Unofficial Alchemist,' but that doesn't mean I don't have all the skills of a real one!
0.1: A lot of people think it's weird that a fairy learned alchemy, but who cares? Isn't it important to learn what you want to learn? Research is so much fun!
0.2: Lately, I've been researching the Roid. They're mechanical contraptions made by the Alcadno's alchemists. That's... also the reason why I am in a bit of a tight spot. Do you think you can help with my research?

yes.0: Heehee. Thanks! Can you get me some Roid's Blueprint Fragments? It's really hard to study Roid without some reference material, and all the veteran alchemists give me an earful whenever I ask about it.

no.0: Whaaat? Even a traveler like you seems busy these days. Is it because of the research? Then work with me!
